name: Evi
overview: Evi was a male figure identified as the King of Midian, according to Numbers 31:8. The biblical text does not provide information about his tribal affiliation or additional personal details. His role as a king places him among the leadership of the Midianites during the period described in the Old Testament.
namesAndTitles: The name Evi means 'desire' and is a proper name mentioned in Numbers 31:8. There is no indication that this name was given by God, but it serves as a straightforward identifier within the biblical narrative.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Evi beyond his position as King of Midian. No relatives or kinship connections are listed in the available biblical account.
scriptureSignificance: Evi's significance in Scripture centers on his leadership role as King of Midian during a time of conflict involving the Israelites. His mention highlights the opposition faced by God's people and the unfolding of divine judgment against the Midianites. Though details are limited, Evi represents the earthly rulers who stood against God's purposes in the Old Testament narrative.
